content.description: Exploded view diagram showing fuel pump assembly components including fuel pump bracket at top with hoses, fuel pump in center, fuel pump filter, rubber cushion, and clip at bottom. Diamond symbols indicate non-reusable parts.

content.text: WARNING: Avoid smoking and open flame when working on the fuel pump.

content.description: Illustration showing hands removing fuel pump bracket from fuel tank, with arrows indicating removal direction

items.heading: REMOVE FUEL PUMP BRACKET FROM FUEL TANK
substeps: (b) Pull out the fuel pump bracket.

content.description: Illustration showing hands removing fuel pump from fuel pump bracket, with arrows indicating disconnection of wires and removal direction

items.heading: REMOVE FUEL PUMP FROM FUEL PUMP BRACKET
substeps: (a) Remove the two nuts and disconnect the wires from the fuel pump.
(b) Pull off the bracket from the lower side of the fuel pump.
(c) Remove the fuel pump from the fuel hose.
